"Headband" is a song by American hip hop recording artist B.o.B.
It was released on May 21, 2013, as the lead single from his third studio album, Underground Luxury (2013).
The song, produced by American hip hop record producer Mustard, features a guest appearance from fellow American rapper 2 Chainz.
Underground Luxury is the third studio album by American rapper B.o.B.
The album was released on December 17, 2013, by Grand Hustle Records, Rebel Rock Entertainment and Atlantic Records.
The album was produced by B.o.B himself, alongside Rebel Rock founder Jim Jonsin, Arthur McArthur, Big Zar, DJ Mustard, DJ Toomp, FnZ, FKi 1st, Geoffro Cause, Detail, Marz, Mike Will Made It, R.
